# Visahouse (AMG Visa) — Full Pakistan Visa Knowledge Base

> Last updated: 2026-11-27. Source: https://visahouse.online. Visahouse is a private consultancy, not a government body or embassy. Final decisions rest with the authorities.

- Contact Email: info@visahouse.online
- Working Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 – 19:00 PKT

## Consultancy Overview, Scope & Fee Tiers
- Operator & Service Cities: Visahouse (visahouse.online) — online-first visa consultancy desk affiliated with the AMG Visa network (amgvisa.com) (Islamabad · Lahore · Karachi (Online Desk across Pakistan))
- Scope of Practice: Private administrative visitor, tourist, and business visa document auditing, form drafting, itinerary preparation, official-channel appointment guidance, and travel insurance quote coordination. Visahouse does not act as licensed legal counsel for asylum, tribunal appeals, or permanent residency under CICC/RCIC (Canada), MARA (Australia), IAA/OISC (UK), or U.S. immigration law.
- Standard Consultation Fee Tiers (Tourist Baseline): Schengen (17 states + Schengen Area) & USA: PKR 30,000 | UK, Canada, Australia & New Zealand: PKR 40,000 | Japan, South Korea & South Africa: PKR 25,000.
- Multi-Applicant & Bank FX Notes: Additional companions in the same file receive a 15% consultancy service discount. Pakistani bank cards used on online mission portals (GOV.UK, IRCC, ImmiAccount, e-Visa) typically incur ~4–5% international FX conversion, FED, and withholding charges on billing day.
- Official Payment Safety: Settle consultancy invoices strictly into the official corporate bank account listed on your written Visahouse invoice—never transfer fees to personal third-party accounts or unauthorised slot brokers.
- Privacy & Retention: Passport scans, CNIC/FRC copies, and six-month bank statements are purged within 30–60 days after visa decision, or immediately upon written request.

- Region: Southeast Asia | Channel: Hybrid / Centre | Visa Type: Tourist Visa (TR) / e-Visa channel (Single or Multiple Entry (category-dependent))
- Official Channel / Centre: Royal Thai e-Visa Portal / Authorised Drop-Off Handling
- Indicative Processing: 5–10 working days
- Indicative Fees (Verify Live): Govt USD 40 | Visahouse Consultation PKR 14,500
- Summary: Structured file preparation, bank-statement review, and authorised submission guidance for Pakistani travellers heading to Bangkok, Phuket, Krabi, or Chiang Mai.
- Key Advisory: Submission jurisdiction depends on your province of residence or CNIC issuance (Islamabad, Lahore, or Karachi submission desks) as well as whether the Royal Thai Embassy currently routes your category through the official e-Visa portal or designated drop-off centres.
- Core Documents: Original Pakistani Passport & Previous Passports; Valid CNIC / B-Form Copies; Recent Biometric Photographs; Return Flight Itinerary & Hotel Confirmations; Signed Bank Statement & Account Maintenance Certificate

Travellers eligible for Turkey’s conditional e-Visa must also meet strict boarding checks at Pakistani departure airports (confirmed round-trip ticket, verifiable hotel booking, and proof of funds of at least USD 50 per day).

### United States Visa from Pakistan
- URL: https://visahouse.online/visas/usa
- Region: North America | Channel: Interview / Consulate | Visa Type: B1/B2 Non-Immigrant Visitor Visa (Business / Tourism) (Multiple or Single Entry (visa officer discretion))
- Official Channel / Centre: U.S. Embassy Islamabad / Consulate Karachi (MRV Fee)
- Indicative Processing: Appointment wait varies; 5–15 working days post-interview
- Indicative Fees (Verify Live): Govt USD 185 | Visahouse Consultation PKR 30,000
- Summary: Disciplined B1/B2 visitor visa guidance, accurate DS-160 drafting, official appointment scheduling support, and realistic embassy interview coaching for Pakistani applicants.
- Key Advisory: Under Section 214(b) of US immigration law, every B1/B2 decision hinges primarily on your DS-160 application and your brief live conversation with the visa officer—never on thick stacks of unrequested paper. Truthful, concise preparation is everything. Also note: interview-waiver ("Dropbox") renewal rules are tightly restricted (confirm current 12-month same-category eligibility), and STEM, medical, or engineering profiles can face Section 221(g) administrative processing lasting several weeks—apply 4–6 months ahead.
- Core Documents: Valid Pakistani Passport & All Previous Passports; DS-160 Confirmation Page (With Barcode); Official Appointment Confirmation & MRV Fee Receipt; Recent 2×2 Inch (51mm × 51mm) US-Spec Photograph; Employment Letter, Recent Pay Slips, or Business Registration

## Frequently Asked Questions (Pakistani Passport Holders)

### How early should Pakistani passport holders apply before their travel date?
Lead times depend heavily on the submission channel. For Schengen Type-C visas, applications may generally be lodged up to six months ahead, and starting 10 to 14 weeks early is prudent before summer or Eid travel peaks so you can secure a legitimate VFS Global or BLS appointment. Embassy sticker visas such as Japan or South Korea are best initiated 6 to 8 weeks ahead, Southeast Asian and Gulf e-Visas 3 to 4 weeks ahead, and US B1/B2 interviews several months in advance due to Islamabad and Karachi waitlists.

### How do timelines differ between e-Visas, embassy drop-boxes, and biometric centres?
Online e-Visa portals (such as Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Bahrain, or Uzbekistan) review digital uploads without taking your physical passport, so turnaround begins as soon as the portal payment clears. Embassy drop-box missions (such as Japan and South Korea) assess physical paper visa files and return passports through their designated counter or courier. Biometric visa centres (Schengen VFS/BLS, UK, USA) require booking an in-person slot first—embassy processing only starts after your biometrics and physical folder are logged.

### Does my Pakistani passport remain with the embassy during visa processing?
Yes for sticker visas—including Schengen missions, Japan, South Korea, and the United States—your original passport stays with the embassy or consulate until a decision is stamped and dispatched. For pure e-Visas, you retain your passport throughout review. Avoid scheduling back-to-back international trips or purchasing non-refundable airline tickets while your passport is lodged.

### What causes unexpected visa delays for applicants filing from Pakistan?
Common bottlenecks include public holidays in both Pakistan and the destination country, Eid and summer peak caseload surges, bank-statement verification inquiries, and provincial jurisdiction errors between Islamabad and Karachi missions. Incomplete PDF scans, mismatched hotel dates, or missing employer leave confirmations also trigger document holdbacks that add days or weeks to an otherwise routine file.

### What passport validity and blank page requirements apply to Pakistani passports?
Most Asian, Gulf, and global destinations require your Pakistani passport to have at least six months of remaining validity from your entry or return date, plus at least two consecutive blank visa pages. Schengen missions require validity of at least three months beyond your planned exit from the Schengen Area and an issue date within the past ten years. Always include clear colour copies of prior visas and entry/exit stamps from current and expired passports to support your travel history.

### What bank statement and tax records do embassies expect from Pakistan?
Embassies typically ask for a stamped six-month personal bank statement (plus company statement for business owners) showing steady income, regular operating activity, and a closing balance proportionate to your trip length, paired with a signed Account Maintenance Certificate (AMC) on bank letterhead. Adding your FBR NTN registration and recent Income Tax Returns reinforces financial credibility. Avoid sudden, unexplained cash deposits shortly before lodging your file.

### Which employment, business, and NADRA civil documents prove ties to Pakistan?
Salaried applicants should provide an original Employer No Objection Certificate (NOC) on company letterhead confirming job title, tenure, salary, and approved leave dates, accompanied by the last three salary slips. Self-employed applicants should include business NTN, Chamber of Commerce or SECP incorporation records, and business letterhead. To document family ties, include valid CNIC copies, a NADRA Family Registration Certificate (FRC), Marriage Registration Certificate (MRC) for spouses, and B-Form / school NOC for travelling children.

### Are travel insurance, hotel bookings, and flight reservations required before approval?
For Schengen applications, travel medical insurance covering at least €30,000 in emergency medical care and repatriation across all Schengen member states for your entire trip is strictly mandatory at submission. Most embassies accept verifiable flight reservations and refundable hotel bookings aligned day-by-day with your cover letter—do not buy non-refundable flights unless a specific mission requires it. After approval, remember pre-flight digital arrival cards (such as Malaysia MDAC, Singapore SGAC, Visit Japan Web, or Philippines eTravel).
